subject: Mock capability tool to Host-owned dashboard JSON to subscribed UI end-to-end loop
inside: Finite capability mock tool registry and deterministic tool request
Tool-to-dashboard-action composition without paths or UI source
Existing binding, revision, idempotency and atomic JSON persistence
Capability dashboard changed event emitted after committed mutation
Frontend event subscription, document reload and registry rendering
Floating prototype-only trigger and visible execution state

outside.system: Real MCP protocol transport and model runtime
outside.contract: invokeTool(toolName, scope) returns only after requesting a declared Host dashboard action; unsupported names fail closed.
The mock tool supplies labeled deterministic values and provenance that must not be presented as live platform data.

outside.system: Production MCP progress and task protocol
outside.contract: The prototype exposes local pending/success/failure state only; no durable MCP run lifecycle is claimed.

outside.system: Cross-process event delivery and cloud sync
outside.contract: Wails process-local events notify mounted clients; reopening still recovers from task JSON.
